thread.title: Amazon on track to cross $900 billion market-cap threshold - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Amazon on track to cross $900 billion market-cap threshold - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +0.29% shot up 4.3% toward a record high in premarket trade Friday, after blowout second-quarter results , to put the e-commerce giant on track to cross above the $900 billion market-capitalization threshold for first time. At current stock price levels, Amazon would be valued at about $919.4 billion. That would still make it the second-biggest U.S. company, as Apple Inc. shares' AAPL, -2.03% premarket gain of 0.3% would put the technology giant at about $957.9 billion.
